title: John Harbaugh’s pledge to start kicking ‘the Cowboys’ ass’ fires up Giants fans

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: John Harbaugh’s pledge to start kicking ‘the Cowboys’ ass’ fires up Giants fans
sources.description: Asked by a fan about the Giants finally turning around their losing, John Harbaugh pumped his fist in the air as a “Cowboys suck!” chant rang out.
